extension.summary: Play a folder of mixed audio and video files as one playlist
extension.description: Plain folder view without library: titles of the current folder on the left, video on the right (empty for audio). Previous/next, fullscreen, sort by name or modification date.
extension.news: 0.3.4 - click or tap on the progress bar seeks to that position (mouse and touch) 0.3.3 - opening a folder selects its first entry instead of ".." 0.3.2 - long press OK on an entry opens an action menu: play from here / play only this / move 0.3.1 - play button and play/pause media key start the highlighted folder/title while nothing is playing 0.3.0 - custom order per folder (long press OK on an entry = move, auto-saved, reset button), sort mode per folder, shuffle, Windows path support 0.2.6 - all transport buttons stay focusable while nothing plays (disabled controls are skipped by remote navigation) 0.2.5 - rewind/forward buttons (Kodi speed steps), sort moved above the list, fullscreen as corner icon on the video 0.2.4 - icon buttons (PNG, standard media symbols; play/pause toggles with state), high-contrast progress bar (green on black, framed) 0.2.3 - Play/Pause button (Prev / Play-Pause / Next / Stop), plain-text button labels, visible progress on the focused seek bar 0.2.2 - play order now matches the visible list: subfolders play at their position (before the files) 0.2.1 - normal playback (OK on a title) continues into the subfolders after the folder's files 0.2.0 - play folder incl. subfolders (long press OK on a folder), seekable progress bar (left/right = 10 s, OK = pause) 0.1.1 - English UI, button layout, fullscreen kept across titles, optional log file 0.1.0 - first test version
